generalAbilities.name: Emotion Sense
generalAbilities.description: A shimmerstone sentinel can sense the emotions of creatures within the listed range as an imprecise sense. Emotion sense is a precise sense against creatures under an emotion effect. A creature under the effects of calm can't be noticed via emotion sense.

defensiveAbilities.name: Absorb Aggression
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The shimmerstone sentinel is damaged by a creature that isn't immune to emotion effects and is within 60 feet

Effect The shimmerstone sentinel absorbs the negative emotions of its attacker, causing its shimmerstone to darken to cloudy red, and becomes emotionally charged.

defensiveAbilities.name: Calming Presence
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. Shimmerstone sentinels exude an aura of calm. Each time a creature in the area attempts an offensive action, such as an attack or casting a spell, that creature must attempt a DC 29 Will Saving Throw save; on a failure, the action is disrupted. A creature that succeeds becomes temporarily immune to the shimmerstone sentinel's calming presence for 1 day.

offensiveAbilities.name: Emotionally Charged
offensiveAbilities.description: A shimmerstone sentinel that's emotionally charged deals an additional 1d8 Mental Damage damage with its Strikes. In addition, a creature damaged by an emotionally charged shimmerstone sentinel's fist or shimmer beam Strike is bombarded by emotion and must attempt a DC 32 Will Saving Throw save. On a critical failure, the creature becomes Confused for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Inexorable March
offensiveAbilities.description: The shimmerstone sentinel Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can bar the way by succeeding at a DC 32 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it's damaged as if hit by the shimmerstone sentinel's fist.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unleash Emotion
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The shimmerstone sentinel is emotionally charged

Effect The shimmerstone sentinel releases the negative emotions it absorbed in a 30ft Type:emanation that affects the minds of nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take 7d6 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 32 Will Saving Throw save). On a failure, a creature becomes Confused for 1 round, or for 1d4 rounds on a critical failure. The shimmerstone sentinel is no longer emotionally charged.
